preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(a) <= 10**5 for a in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string a in test cases has a length between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(b) <= 10**5 for b in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string b in test cases has a length between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in a) for a in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each character in string a is an uppercase letter.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in b) for b in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each character in string b is an uppercase letter.

postconditions.expression: len(result) == sum(len(a) + len(b) for a, b in test_cases)
postconditions.description: The length of the result is the sum of the lengths of all strings a and b in the test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in result)
postconditions.description: Each character in the result is an uppercase letter.

postconditions.expression: result == ''.join(min(a[i:] + b[j:], b[i:] + a[j:]) for i, j in zip(range(len(test_cases)), [0]*len(test_cases)))
postconditions.description: The result is the lexicographically minimal string formed by interleaving the characters from the stacks a and b.
